title: Nourishing Smoky American Italian Chicken Casserole
description: A comforting and creamy casserole featuring Italian seasoning and a smoky flavor, made with fresh ingredients and Ayurvedic-sattvic friendly principles.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
In a large skillet, cook the chicken over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through.
In a separate bowl, combine the canned diced tomatoes and plain Greek yogurt.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange a layer of cooked chicken.
Spread half of the tomato-yogurt mixture over the chicken.
Sprinkle with half of the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Repeat the layers, starting with the chicken, then the remaining tomato-yogurt mixture, and finally the remaining mozzarella cheese.
Top with chopped fresh basil leaves.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
